metric: Mobile devices manufactured in Egypt
label: Egypt - 2025

metric: Specialists exporting digital services
label: Egypt
observation_period: no reference year stated; as reported 2026-09-28

metric: Egyptian digital services export targets
label: Egypt - 2029 target

metric: Egyptian digital services export targets
label: Egypt - interim 2028 milestone

metric: Teachers trained under Kenya's Digital Literacy Programme
label: Kenya
note: Cumulative national figure attributed to the ICT Authority for Phase II of the Digital Literacy Programme (KDEAP, with World Bank support). Trained teachers are not equipment delivered, classroom use or learning outcomes. Phase II targets 10,382 public junior schools across 47 counties: that is a planned scope, not a delivered count, and is not recorded as an observation.

metric: Digital skills training places
label: Nigeria
note: Announced by the federal government under the Nigeria Education Sector Renewal Initiative, delivered through the Nigeria Education Digital Infrastructure programme. The same report states 72,850 applications, 19,699 meeting the eligibility criteria and a first cohort of 16,000 selected. Places offered, applications received and selections made are not completions, certifications or jobs.

metric: Citizens to receive AI training

Announced training capacity, not completed training, certified participants or employment outcomes.

metric: 5G spectrum licence price
